<!-- Simple PR template for magrizzly-web -->
## Summary
- Brief description of the change and why it was made.

## Files changed
- List the files you modified (e.g., `index.html`, `public/styles/site.css`).

## Checklist
- Does this change keep `index.html` at the repository root? (yes/no)
- Are new static assets placed under `public/`? (yes/no)
- No package.json or build tooling added without approval. (yes/no)
- Small, dependency-free CSS/JS when added. (yes/no)

## Notes for reviewers
- Any special preview steps (e.g., `npx serve .` in PowerShell).
